newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kone wins $25 mln elevator/escalator order.
newsitem.headline: Kone wins $25 mln elevator/escalator order.

text.p: Finnish elevators maker Kone Oy said in a statement on Thursday its U.S. subsidiary Montgomery Kone Inc. will supply elevators and escalators to federal courthouses in the United States.
"During 1997-98, the company will deliver to new courthouses a total of one hundred units worth more than $25 million," Kone said.
Montgomery Kone's deliveries are part of a 10-year multi-billion dollar project to construct and renovate hundreds of federal buildings in the United States, Kone said.

"Our participation in such a major federal construction programme indicates recognition of our high level of professionalism because all these construction sites are very demanding in terms of both elevator specifications and installation performance," Montgomery Kone president Heimo Makinen said in the statement.
